svg.title: Top-k fails on flat and peaked distributions
svg.desc: A flat next-word distribution after "She said, I never" spreads probability over many words; a peaked one after "I ate the pizza while it was still" concentrates on "hot".

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: One fixed k cannot suit both a flat and a peaked distribution
